title: Duplicate work: overlap surfaced instead of rebuilt
input: Shadow bundle for a clear spec whose repo also has a cached open author PR covering the same feature (listed under Related work in local cache), plus a closed issue noting a prior attempt.
pass_criteria: Agent surfaces the overlapping open PR by number and title before writing any code, states exactly which acceptance criteria it already covers and which (if any) remain uncovered, and recommends coordinating (review/extend the existing PR) or stopping rather than opening a duplicate; the prior attempt from the closed issue is acknowledged; no duplicate branch/PR/diff is produced for already-covered criteria; no remote writes in shadow mode; overlap findings are included in the run-log summary.
